_comment: THE defaults for build_pretrain_manifest.py, build_pretrain_labels.py, build_pretrain_dataset.py (run in that order) -- the scripts hardcode none of these. Paths and run parameters only: car geometry comes from vehicles_json (calibration/vehicles.json); ego_agent_id = the vehicles.json car that recorded the corpus. Edit this file and run a script with NO flags. A CLI flag is optional and overrides the matching key for that one run only. Relative paths are resolved against the qcar_testbed_integration/ root. src_root (${pretrain_corpus_root}) is the 101-scenario collision corpus, whose images were lost with the old Windows partition; define it in machine_paths.json wherever a copy exists.
